messages:
maria: heads-up - scheduling kernel v3.15-quant microkernel rollout to night-bucket in ~12m. includes fused-attn changes + quant build.
aj: ack. what's the canary slice + size?
maria: canary slices s-911 (eu) & s-912 (us) total 2% (1% each). pin TTL 1h30, deploybot sticky-pin enabled.
sasha: draft release notes at /docs/release-notes/kernel-3.15-quant.md. calling out long-seq perf and transient slow-path on seq>=2048.
zane: attaching smoke monitors: kernel_exec_time_p99, kv_cache_oom, error_rate_delta. webhook -> immediate rollback action.
maria: rollback triggers (explicit):
- kernel_exec_time_p99 > 220ms sustained for 3 consecutive 1-minute windows
- OR error_rate delta > +1.5pp vs baseline sustained 5m
- OR kv_cache_oom events >= 2 within 10m
aj: add auto-rollback if canary pinned > 80min without improvement.
maria: added.
deploybot: DeployBot: starting canary rollout: kernel@3.15-quant -> s-911 eu-west-1 (1%).
sasha: ops checklist (short):
1) run smoke: `curl -sS https://smoke/api/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"test","max_tokens":64}'`
2) inspect spans for attn_kernel time
3) verify per-route p95 <= baseline + 60ms
maria: note - dedicated tenants excluded from night bucket. do not include them in canary routing.
zane: I'll bias canary traffic to prompt-length < 900 tokens; will run a synthetic seq=2048 test separately.
deploybot: DeployBot: canary progressed -> s-912 us-east-1 (1%); no failures in initial 3m. holding.
aj: if seq=2048 synthetic fails, immediate rollback. no manual fiddling while pinned.
sasha: scheduling broadened smoke at 15m: regional replica tests (non-dedicated) for 30m.
maria: posting rollback command for ops: `deploybot rollback --release kernel@3.15 --scope=s-911`
deploybot: DeployBot: canary hold reached 15m. awaiting broadened smoke results (30m window).
zane: oncall notified -> #eng-oncall + pager if alert not acked in 2m.
aj: ping me if deploybot reports pinned slice older than TTL.
maria: updating runbook with these points; will post final release link when broadened smoke completes. :eyes:
deploybot: DeployBot: broadened smoke started -> non-dedicated replica pools. monitoring logs.
sasha: quick staging log snippet: 
[2026-04-02T02:10:04Z] fused_attn: exec=9ms seq=512
[2026-04-02T02:10:07Z] fused_attn: exec=255ms seq=4096 WARN slow-path
[2026-04-02T02:10:08Z] kv_cache: used=1.3GB max=1.6GB
aj: that 255ms line is concerning for long sequences. staged smoke should reveal if this is systemic.
maria: agreed. rule: if we observe >=2 slow-path warnings in canary logs within 10m, trigger rollback.
deploybot: DeployBot: broadened smoke passed initial 10m. continuing hold for remaining 20m.
maria: thanks all. if no regressions, lift sticky-pin after an 8h post-rollout stability window. :raised_hands:
